title: SR-1.16 Docs and code say the same thing
request: Closes G16: Help omits real subcommands; CLIENTS.md says sync every few minutes (default 30); delete is not reconciled; dependency claim overstated. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

requirements: memev help lists every dispatched command and subcommand
help.test.mjs takes the dispatched commands from the dispatch code (OPTIONAL, the switch cases and each command module's sub === chains), never from what help is printed from

the refactor keeps every gate the command bodies hold: --yes before cloud on and before the public funnel, operator and rename only on the vault's own computer, and <command> --help printing help and doing nothing else
